📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Mai, Ernesto, Catalina, Henry and Petra met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Mai, Ernesto, Catalina, Henry are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Big Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ernesto just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mai, Ernesto, Catalina, Farid and Dmitri met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Ernesto, Catalina, Farid, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📓 Codex: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — jotted down what they said. Filed.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Petra was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Akua taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Cauã has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Akua is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Guoqiang just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
